### The Lord Calls Gideon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-calls-gideon
Passage: Judges 6:27
Points:
- Israel's oppression under Midian stemmed from the spiritual root problem of turning to false gods.
- Before God would deliver His people, false worship had to be purged, starting with Gideon's own household.
- Gideon followed the Lord's instructions to tear down Baal's altar, but fear of his family and neighbors led him to act by night.
- Believers often struggle with the fear of man and need God-given courage to obey His Word regardless of opposition.

### Bible Pathways 03/24/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-24-or-2002-1127524.html
Passage: Judges 6:25
Points:
- True worship of God requires action, beginning with tearing down the idols that compromise devotion to Him.
- Following God's directives often means standing alone and breaking with the traditions of family and community.
- The burnt offering offered on the new altar represented complete and unconditional surrender to the Lord.
- God uses ordinary, hesitant people who simply choose to trust His Word rather than rely on worldly status or power.
